fields.label: Business
fields.description: Which connected business this row belongs to. Consolidated is a GROUP BY on this column; a single business is a filter.

fields.label: Source Modified
fields.description: The source document's modified timestamp at extraction. Drives the incremental watermark.

fields.label: Source Docstatus
fields.description: 0 draft · 1 submitted · 2 cancelled

fields.label: Fact Key
fields.description: sha1 of business + source doctype + document + row. Makes a reload replace rather than duplicate.

fields.label: Party Type
fields.description: Customer or Supplier

fields.label: Aged As At
fields.description: The data horizon the ageing is measured to, never today by default.

fields.label: Ledger Balance
fields.description: From the General Ledger: for a customer debits less credits, for a supplier credits less debits. Negative means the party is in credit.

fields.label: Owed
fields.description: The ledger balance where positive: what the party really owes, or what we really owe them.

fields.label: In Credit
fields.description: The ledger balance where negative, as a positive amount: paid in advance, or paid more than was billed.

fields.label: Why the invoices say something else
On Open Invoices
fields.description: The outstanding amounts of submitted invoices that are still open, as the invoices themselves state them.

fields.label: Payments Not Matched
fields.description: Payments received from a customer (or made to a supplier) and never matched to an invoice: their unallocated amounts.

fields.label: Journal Credits Not Linked
fields.description: Journal entries that reduce what is owed and are not linked to any invoice.

fields.label: Credit Notes Not Set Against An Invoice
fields.description: Credit notes (returns) whose own balance is still open because they were never set against the original invoice.

fields.label: Other Unlinked
fields.description: Payments matched to orders or journal entries instead of invoices, and ledger entries of other kinds. Negative when they add to what is owed.

fields.label: Debits Not On An Invoice
fields.description: Journal entries and refunds that add to what is owed without being on an invoice, such as opening balances.

fields.label: Not Shown On The Invoices
fields.description: Payments and credit notes the ledger already records against these invoices that the invoices' own outstanding amounts do not show. Negative when the invoices show less than the ledger holds against them.

fields.label: Unexplained
fields.description: Whatever the records do not account for. Open invoices less every credit above plus the debits equals the ledger balance; this is the remainder, normally zero.

fields.label: Owed With No Date
fields.description: Owed by the ledger but on no dated item to age it by (the ledger holds more than the open items explain).

fields.label: Inside 90 Days
fields.description: Not yet due plus up to 90 days overdue.

fields.label: Overdue
fields.description: Everything past its due date, after matching.

fields.label: Oldest Due Date After Matching
fields.description: Unmatched payments and credits are set against the oldest open items first; this is the due date of the oldest item still open after that.

fields.label: Days Overdue
fields.description: From the oldest due date after matching to the as-of date.
